preconditions.name: pag_freeze_and_ilpfc_gate_engage_on_base
preconditions.description: The 603h chain must be present on ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY: PAG freezes (pag_n_commits>0 on >=2/3 seeds) AND the ilPFC gate engages (n_credit+n_decay>0 on >=2/3). Below-floor => the gate/freeze substrate the bridge extends is itself inert => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a bridge verdict.
preconditions.control: ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY: PAG + ilPFC gate + driver + fed harm stream (= 603h INTACT).

preconditions.name: each_enabled_bridge_half_fires_nonvacuously
preconditions.description: Each ENABLED bridge half must increment its credit on >=2/3 seeds (ARM_RELIEF_BRIDGE: mech358_n_relief_credit>0; ARM_SAFETY_BRIDGE: mech358_n_safety_credit>0; ARM_RELIEF_SAFETY_BRIDGE: both). This is the SAME mechanism the PRIMARY G_H lift routes on -- the bridge cannot lift survival if it never credited an escape affordance. Below-floor => the relief detector starved (needs a trained encoder/world-forward; it re-starved on 603h n_credit 6/0) => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a bridge verdict.
preconditions.control: ARM_RELIEF/SAFETY/RELIEF_SAFETY: bridge ON, SD-056 e2 warmup in P0, fed harm stream so a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a / terminates the threat actually credits.

preconditions.name: stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal_on_base
preconditions.description: Stage-0 forced supra-threshold benefit lights z_goal (>0.4) on >=2/3 base seeds -- the goal-FORMATION positive control (shared from 603g/603h). Confirms the curriculum is intact.

grid.both_required_pass: avoidance needs complementary relief + safety bridge
grid.neither_and_nav_control_fails: navigation/survival-competence ceiling -> nav substrate, NOT the bridge
